thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Org 'LumenNet' high qps spike detected (433% above baseline). Errors rising (429s) on /v1/generate. Pager triggered to oncall: ash_sre
ash_sre: I'm on it. Can someone grab customer-facing impact?
maria_sre: Monitoring - increased 5xx/4xx from their org id 64218. 429s at edge + elevated latency.
kevin_support: LumenNet (acct #64218) just escalated via support chat, says throughput dropped and requests are queuing. No obvious config changes from their side.
liz_cx: Customer visible errors: ~30% of requests failing with 429. They pushed a batch job at 16:05 UTC.
ash_sre: OK. Immediate mitigation options: 1) temporary org rate bump 2) enable fair-share soft-queueing 3) disable non-essential features on their account (e.g., "rich_preview") to reduce token cost. Any objections?
sre_manager: Go for a controlled org bump + disable heavy features. Keep rollback path ready.
ash_sre: ops-bot, please apply temporary quota bump to 750rps for org 64218 and disable feature flag lumen_rich_preview. Timestamped window 30m.
ops-bot: Received. Running change: admin-cli org update --org 64218 --rate-limit 750rps --flags "lumen_rich_preview=false" --note "Emergency spike mitigation 1845678901"
ops-bot: Change applied. New rate-limit: 750rps. Flag lumen_rich_preview disabled. Rolling config to edge in ~15s. :white_check_mark:
maria_sre: Metrics: error rate dropping from 30% -> 8% within 2 mins, p95 latency down ~120ms. CPU on serving pool still higher than baseline but stable.
kevin_support: Informed LumenNet support rep and asked them to confirm traffic pattern. They acknowledged and paused the ingestion job.
ash_sre: Good. Can someone capture the quick verification snippet of logs/metrics?
maria_sre: Quick fetch from metrics API:
```
GET /internal/metrics?org=64218&window=5m
{
  "requests": 12.3k,
  "429": 985 -> 102 (post-change),
  "p95": 620ms -> 500ms
}
```
ash_sre: Nice. Plan: monitor for 30 mins, if stable we keep config and open a follow-up with customer success to coordinate permanent quota change or rate-limited rollout. If flares again, we'll route them to dedicated capacity or enforce stricter QoS.
liz_cx: I'll schedule a 1:1 with the customer to discuss permanent options and note what we did.
kevin_support: Customer wants a note that we applied a temporary rate bump and disabled previews; they're happy for now.
sre_manager: Ash, handoff to next oncall in 25 mins. Please add runbook steps and ticket.
ash_sre: Will do. Creating internal ticket INC-184567 (temp bump for LumenNet) and adding logs + config diff. Also adding manual rollback instructions:
```
admin-cli org update --org 64218 --rate-limit 250rps --flags "lumen_rich_preview=true" --note "Rollback after spike"
```
ash_sre: Handoff: @maria_sre will monitor next 20m, @ash_sre going to wrap with support and then hand to night oncall. @sre_manager included for visibility. :thumbsup:
maria_sre: Monitoring alerts set. Will escalate if error rate rises above 10% for 3 consecutive minutes.
incident-bot: Note: post-incident review required; assign to ash_sre and liz_cx.
kevin_support: Adding customer-facing blurb to the support ticket now.
ash_sre: Closing loop for now. We applied emergency rate adjustment, disabled non-critical flag, verified improvements, customer notified. Revert plan and follow-up in ticket.
sre_manager: Thanks team. We'll add a short RCA to the weekly oncall review.
kevin_support: :white_check_mark:
ash_sre: Handoff completed at 1845679775 - next oncall: maria_sre.
maria_sre: Acknowledged. I have logs and will keep watch.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled to auto-check change after 30m and notify channel.
